claims.disproof_condition: Lower toward 3 if any major humanoid maker publicly qualifies a non-HDS strain-wave supplier in under 2 years or Chinese suppliers win named non-domestic humanoid sockets; raise toward 5 if challengers remain confined to low-end/domestic sockets through 2027 while HDS wins named humanoid design-ins.
claims.statement: Substitutability valuation for the HDS strain-wave supply edge: 4 of 5. Rationale for 4 not 5: HDS is not sole — Leaderdrive (688017.SS, adopted by Chinese humanoid makers) and Nidec (FLEXWAVE, six productized series) are named at-scale challengers already in this graph. Rationale for 4 not 3: switching friction is high — 3-7 year qualification cycles (existing graph claim) plus zero-backlash performance criticality; the ~85% incumbent-share figure remains a tier-3 attribution (HDS's own page makes no share claim — honestly layered). This is a research judgment, not a source quote; both directions of error are encoded in the disproof.

sources.quote: Because the gear teeth are always fully engaged in a region along the major axis, Harmonic Drive strain wave gearheads have Zero Backlash.

The high performance attributes of this gearing technology including zero backlash, high torque, compact size, excellent positional accuracy and repeatability are all a direct result of the unique operating principle.
